name: greedy_coloring
author: 8809b513
description: Assigns colors to graph nodes with a deterministic greedy algorithm that visits highest-degree nodes first. Use it to find a valid node coloring or estimate how many colors this heuristic needs. Works on directed, undirected, weighted, and unweighted graphs: weights are ignored, and directed edges are treated as undirected conflicts. Returns the total color count, color-class sizes, and up to top_k node assignments with IDs and labels.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to color.

top_k.description: Maximum number of node color assignments to include, ordered by node ID.
